verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a product-lookup API: pass a product URL and get structured pricing, variants, images and merchant offers in one response, under a consistent schema across retailers, with buy URLs included. Availability/stock status is never mentioned, and hands-on community reports show missing prices and a price of '0' for some items, so per-product price data is not reliably complete. missing for 10: documented availability/stock fields, evidence of consistently populated price data, independent corroboration of variant and offer completeness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: Pass any product URL and get structured metadata: pricing, variants, images, and merchant offers in a single response.
Structured product data, with a consistent schema across retailers
Channel3 appends it to buy URLs in the response.
